problems: The proposal carries forward a retrieval limitation that the refutation did not reproduce. Data 4 was publicly retrievable. Its CT00 cells, finite P/q denominators, coverage, correlations and full call-list overlap can be reported directly. The corrected proposal replaces the historical-only claims and restores the measured comparisons.

The proposal omits two source inconsistencies. Figure 4E/F cites Data 3 for SCN enrichment, while the Results cite Data 4 and its workbook contains the matching CT00 (56) tab. Also, the generic animal/growth protocols mention male mice while the SCN captions and sample-specific metadata support two males and one female per diet. Neither the figures nor the labels prove which columns entered the fitted job.
